facts.fact: MICT SETA told Parliament's higher education committee it has disaster recovery plans should the ILMS be compromised, and has chosen Dube Tradeport Data Centre in KwaZulu-Natal for primary, failover and disaster recovery of its data; main site and backup site places not separately stated (place not stated); dated by the document's publication date 2026-08-20.
